changelog:
## v7.8.63 — 2026-10-27 · an early tap on an SVG menu icon is no longer lost + the widget hold is a Turbo++ default + 25 audit fixes
- **Change 1 (bug, measured on koirala):** a menu tapped between page load and the end of APO's held-script pass never opened.
  Both tap holds (`apo-tap-early` and the delay loader's tap capture) chose the control with `closest("button,a,...,[class*=toggle],
  [class*=hamburger],[class*=burger]")` from the tap target. Elementor's nav-menu draws its icon as an inline
  `<svg class="elementor-menu-toggle__icon--open">`, so the SVG was chosen, the REAL click was blocked (its handler was already bound),
  and the replay `.click()` threw on an SVG element (SVG has no `.click()`) inside a try - the tap was lost. Now the lookup starts from the
  nearest HTML element of the tap target (the icon resolves to its `role=button` toggle), and every replay (4 sites) falls back to
  `dispatchEvent(click)` when `.click` is missing. Any toggle with an SVG icon whose class says toggle / hamburger / burger was affected.
- **Change 2:** the v7.8.62 third-party WIDGET hold is now a **Turbo++ default** (`tp_widget_hold` -> `APO_TP_WIDGET`; Maximum
  inherits, Auto resets), made safe for any site first (found by the code audit, `_latest/AUDIT-2026-10-27.md`): a held script that
  another registered script DEPENDS ON is a library, never a widget (server marks `data-apo-lib`; e.g. Google Maps under a theme
  map.js); Maps / YouTube / Vimeo APIs, reCAPTCHA / hCaptcha / Turnstile on the page are libraries; Bedrock `/app/` paths are
  first-party; a widget's window/document load listener registered after the page loaded is still called. **Never adopted on update** (it changes when scripts run - v7.4.2 rule): an existing site gets it when
  Turbo++ / Maximum is applied; `?apo_x=APO_X_TP_WIDGET` still switches it on for a test URL.
- **Presets:** change 1 = no-layout-risk, every preset that emits a tap hold (Turbo++ / Maximum: `delay_js_tap`). Change 2 = carries
  risk -> Turbo++ only (Maximum inherits); Auto explicitly off; Turbo+ and below unchanged (settings diff = `tp_widget_hold` only).
- **Worst case:** (1) a tap held during loading is replayed on the HTML control that contains the icon - the control the visitor
  touched - once, as before for every non-SVG icon; (2) a third-party widget (form, chat, booking box) appears at the first tap / scroll
  / key or after 10 s instead of ~2 s (measured: Jobber form 11.8 s without input, at once after a tap); first-party scripts, library
  CDNs, consent, trackers and payment keep their start; cart / checkout / account never hold.
- **Change 3 (bug, pre-existing, every Turbo++ page with one):** a held `<script nomodule>` never fires load or error in a module
  browser, so the held pass stalled there - no later held script ran, `apo-delay-finish` never fired, the tap hold blocked clicks.
  It is now skipped (a module browser would not run it anyway); a detached widget no longer stalls the widget runner; the loader's
  click hold gives up after 30 s like `apo-tap-early`.
- **Change 4 - code audit fixes (owner: "fix audit results too in v7.8.63"; `_latest/AUDIT-2026-10-27.md`).** Only fixes that are
  correct by construction or make APO do less; nothing changes first-paint layout or script order. **Page cache:** saving a draft /
  auto-draft / private post (or an order, a form entry) no longer purges the HOME page and deletes its learned LCP (`/?p=N` has path
  `/`); the Cache-tab purge keeps `.disabled` and the parked drop-in; a failed minify step stores the unminified page instead of a
  blank one; `DONOTCACHEPAGE` is honoured; `?ref=` / `?source=` are no longer stripped from the cache key (affiliate cookies); the
  drop-in honours the public `apo_off` cookie; a warm-queue URL that fails twice leaves the queue instead of stopping it.
  **LCP:** a stale unscoped hero preload named nowhere else in the page is dropped when APO's own phone/desktop pair exists (koirala:
  the static "preload background images" list still named a replaced hero - 111 KB at high priority on every phone); an AVIF
  preload never keeps a stale `type="image/webp"`; the LCP beacon learns only an image that exists on disk, and its text-reveal
  rule never targets menus / popups / dialogs. **CSS:** six stylesheet deferrals keep the sheet's own `media` (WooCommerce's
  smallscreen sheet applied at every width after load); manual / generated critical CSS no longer gets `\"` for every quote; an
  escaped class selector (`.md\:flex`) is never judged unused; lazy backgrounds restore every element sharing an id; the icon
  subset declines on a page with icon classes the map cannot resolve. **JS:** the dependency closure honours the exclusion lists;
  Accelerator mode's phase-1 loader really loads `apo/p1` (jQuery, core, Elementor never ran with that checkbox); injected scripts go
  before the LAST `</body>` only (7 sites); email decode / CDN rewrite never return a blank page on a PCRE failure. **Admin / files:**
  no public `failed_code.txt` dump (it carried the log salt + warm key); Apply no longer fails under php-fpm (no `-l`); the temp build
  is no longer a `.php` in mu-plugins; wp-config.php is written only when changed, through a temp file; `.htaccess` apply / remove
  never write when the file cannot be read (remove used to leave it EMPTY); the Advisor list renders again; Skip specific pages
  matches `/contact/`; seven list fields are unslashed; two arrow-form fetch callbacks respelled (scanner).
- **Kill switches:** `APO_NO_CLICK_REPLAY` (no tap hold at all), `APO_NO_TP_WIDGET`, `APO_TPW_MS` (10 s); audit: `APO_PURGE_ANY_STATUS`,
  `APO_KEEP_STALE_PRELOAD`, `APO_LCP_NO_FILECHECK`, `APO_CSS_ASYNC_MEDIA_ALL`, `APO_FA_SUBSET_UNRESOLVED`.
- **Measured:** v7.8.62 A/B (n=8 PSI phone): koirala 60 -> 90 (TBT 1899 -> 14 ms), staging 90 -> 97, LCP/FCP/CLS flat, CTA 6/6, Read
  More = apo_off. `test_v7863` 50/50: settings = v7.8.62 + `tp_widget_hold` (Turbo++ / Maximum on, Auto off); `APO_TP_WIDGET` per tier;
  an update keeps it off (control: the same update adopts `warm_lazy_inv` on Maximum); emitted loader on in Turbo++, off in Turbo+ /
  with the kill; real Chrome - a touch on the SVG icon while the held pass is pending opens the menu exactly once through every hold
  path (early script + loader replay, foot-paint wait, p1 wait, the loader's own mid-pass capture); v7.8.62 = never opens (control);
  a `<button><i>` toggle opens once on both builds. Part 2 (58/58): dependency library marked by the server (control: none);
  real Chrome - only the real widget held, nomodule does not stall, the widget's late load listener runs; v7.8.62 held the library
  and the Bedrock script and its nomodule script stalled every held script (control). Part 3 (89/89): every audit fix with v7.8.62
  as control - draft saves keep home, the failing URL leaves the queue, the stale hero hint goes (logo + APO hint kept), escaped
  selectors kept, PCRE failure returns the page, Skip pages, beacon file check + reveal filter, phase-1 loader, critical CSS byte for
  byte, the generated drop-in over HTTP (apo_off cookie / ?ref= fall through, ?utm_ still served).
